acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, high-contrast linear feature is visible on the lower lateral flank, characterized by a series of high-intensity pixel clusters arranged in a jagged line, indicating a distinct physical mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, reticulated pattern of low-intensity pixel regions interwoven with higher-intensity base coat, creating a non-uniform topological texture across the dorsal-lateral surface.
